# Twelve independent trifecta methods — frozen research specification v1 (2026-11-22)

**Goal:** Each of the six favorite and six upset tickets is generated by a DIFFERENT decision rule. These are research candidates, NOT the existing deployed ranked ticket positions. Do not merge or deploy without explicit approval. Freeze rules before testing later dates. No accuracy or profitability is claimed.

## Input contract
Six racers, unique boat numbers 1–6 and independently recorded entry course 1–6. Features must be sourced before prediction time. National and local racer win rate are averaged (local 0.00 falls back to national); NEVER add them. Actual entry course, not boat number, determines inner advantage. Average ST is a pre-race historical statistic; exhibition ST is a different feature and must not be substituted. Motor 2-ren rate is a percent. Last-50 Makulabo and exhibition fields require independent source/time evidence. Missing required features -> that method ABSTAINS, never silently replaces with another method. Equal scores break ties deterministically by course then boat number.

## Six favorite methods (one independently ranked exact trifecta per method)
1. **F1 Ability-first:** first = highest national/local-average ability; second/third = next highest ability, inner course wins only ties.
2. **F2 Start-first:** rank by lower historical average ST, then ability; place three in that order. Requires all six historical average ST.
3. **F3 Inner-advantage:** rank by entry-course advantage weighted by ability (not a fixed boat-one winner). Requires six verified entry courses and abilities.
4. **F4 Motor-first:** rank by motor 2-ren percentage, then ability and entry course. Requires six motor percentages.
5. **F5 Exhibition-first:** rank by lower exhibition time, then ability. Requires six time-stamped exhibition times.
6. **F6 Last50-first:** rank by Makulabo last-50 course-specific top-three rate, then ability. Requires six verified course-specific last-50 records.

## Six upset methods (one independently ranked exact trifecta per method)
1. **U1 Ability leader second:** highest-ability racer placed second; winner chosen from remaining racers by ability adjusted for course; third chosen independently from remaining racers.
2. **U2 Ability leader third:** highest-ability racer placed third; winner and second chosen by start/ability. Requires six historical average ST.
3. **U3 Ability leader outside podium:** exclude highest-ability racer; choose top three from remaining by entry-course-adjusted ability.
4. **U4 Outside-course winner:** winner chosen from entry courses 4–6 by ability and verified start, second/third chosen by ability; requires six verified entry courses and historical ST.
5. **U5 Motor reversal:** winner chosen from racers with top-two motor rate but outside top-two ability, then fill second/third by ability. Abstain when no eligible reversal candidate.
6. **U6 Exhibition reversal:** winner chosen from best two exhibition-time racers outside top-two ability, then fill second/third by ability. Abstain when no eligible reversal candidate.

## Evaluation rules
- Generate predictions **without finish order** and save each method ID, version, input completeness, source/time evidence, exact triple, and explicit abstention reason before race cutoff.
- Authenticate capture timing independently, match official six-boat finish order and official race identity; compare by exact 1st–2nd–3rd order.
- Report each method's numerator, denominator, hit rate and abstention count. Report favorite-six and upset-six any-hit coverage on complete-group races only, and all-twelve any-hit on races where all twelve methods produced predictions. Multiple methods may pick the same triple; no forced uniqueness.
- Evaluate on future dates or a chronological untouched holdout. Do not tune weights on test dates. Separate historical descriptive associations from prospective accuracy.
- **Current archived 2026-11-20 evidence cannot support this evaluation:** 14 ready ranked 6+6 responses but 0 authenticated pre-race captures, 0 verified official cutoffs, and 0 complete six-racer source feature vectors. The 14 old responses are ranked slots, not these methods.

**Status:** method definitions proposed/frozen in research documentation only. Not implemented in deployed app. No measured twelve-method hit rates yet.

## Version 1 tie-break correction

Version 1 applies each method's named primary measure first. Ability is used only when the primary measure ties, followed by lower entry course and then lower boat number. This applies to start-time, motor, exhibition-time, and last-50 methods. Version 0's tiny ability offsets could change a non-tied primary ranking, so results from the two versions must be reported separately.
